purpose: Strengthen PA-NF v2 using only revision-1 synthetic smoke evidence while continuing to isolate all frozen 2026-09-29 SCORPION confirmation outcomes from development.

revision_1_observation.interpretation: Crossed intervention improved acquisition transfer and passed all-seed crossed factorization, but biological retention weakened relative to the matched control. Raw latent-cycle MSE was also worse, but raw MSE can reward small or collapsed latent geometry and is therefore replaced by a variance-normalized cycle diagnostic in revision 2.

allowed_development_evidence: non-confirmatory diagnostics produced by the revision-2 runner
isolation.confirmation_rule: Any promoted PA-NF v2 configuration must be frozen before a new prospective confirmation experiment.

architectures.difference: Candidate enables crossed reconstruction plus biological and acquisition cycle-preservation losses. Control has the exact same encoders, decoder, scanner prototypes, same-scanner acquisition consistency, biological consistency, variance floor, and prototype regularizers, but sets crossed and both cycle weights to zero.

representation.scanner_prototypes: training-only anchors for image-inferred acquisition embeddings

cycle_metric.reason: Avoid rewarding low-amplitude or collapsed latent codes merely because their raw MSE is numerically small. Raw cycle MSE remains descriptive.

development_promotion_gate.note: This remains a development promotion gate only and is not a confirmatory scientific claim.

prospective_confirmation_target.primary_contrast: frozen PA-NF v2 minus identical-capacity v2 control lacking crossed/cycle losses
